profile.headline: Backend Software Engineer | PHP, Symfony & Laravel | REST APIs | Docker | DDD & Hexagonal Architecture | AI integrations
profile.geoLocationName: Santa Uxía de Ribeira, Galicia, Spain
profile.summary:
Backend Software Engineer with 18+ years of experience building and evolving web applications, APIs, and backend platforms focused on scalability, maintainability, and long-term product growth.

Specialized in PHP ecosystems, mainly Symfony and Laravel, with strong experience designing REST APIs, modular architectures, and Docker-based environments. Particularly interested in Domain-Driven Design, Hexagonal Architecture, clean code practices, and modern backend engineering workflows.

Throughout my career I have worked mainly in product-oriented environments, collaborating closely with business and product teams to deliver reliable software aligned with real user needs. I also led a development team for more than two years, contributing to both technical direction and team growth.

I enjoy solving complex backend problems, improving system architecture, optimizing development workflows, and building software that is easy to evolve over time. Recently, I have also been exploring AI integrations and AI-assisted development practices applied to modern applications.

Currently open to stable remote opportunities focused on backend engineering, software architecture, and product development.

positions.title: PHP Backend engineer
positions.description:
Worked on the reimplementation and evolution of a REST API platform using Symfony, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and Hexagonal Architecture principles.

Collaborated closely with product teams to design and deliver a new, more scalable version of the platform focused on long-term maintainability, system evolution, and improved development workflows.

Key areas:
• REST API development
• Symfony ecosystem
• DDD & Hexagonal Architecture
• Backend scalability and maintainability
• Product-oriented development
• Technical design and architecture

positions.title: Fullstack Engineer
positions.description:
### Fullstack Engineer — Menéame

Worked across multiple areas of the platform and product ecosystem, contributing to backend development, infrastructure, mobile applications, and operational scalability.

Participated in the development of a new version of the platform using Symfony, while also working on infrastructure management in AWS, platform performance, operational costs optimization, and advertising-related systems.

Contributed to the mobile application development using React Native and collaborated on technical decisions affecting both product evolution and platform reliability.

Being part of one of the most iconic and historic platforms on the Spanish internet ecosystem was a particularly meaningful professional experience.

Key areas:
• Fullstack development
• Symfony & PHP
• React Native
• AWS infrastructure
• Platform scalability and optimization
• Infrastructure cost management
• Product-oriented development
• Technical operations & architecture

projects.title: Control panel, shop and public web (2009)
projects.description:
In September of 2009 Dinahosting launched a new version of their control panel, public web and shop.
The project was composed for 3 components:
- Public web and shop: the new public image of Dinahosting and the new shop was builded using Zend Framework as PHP back-end, pure JavaScript and jQuery in the front-end. The web and shop was replaced in July 2011 for a new version.
- User control panel: the control panel was an innovative control panel concept, it looked like a desktop environment. The JavaScript engine was codified by the Dinahosting team using jQuery, ajax and other client side technics. The backend was full written with PHP and it allowed to manage the products and services of over 50.000 clients around the world . The control panel solution was replaced in the mid 2013 by a new version.
- Business control panel: with the Dinahosting refactoring a new version of business control panel was written. It allowed to the staff to manage the billing, services and customers system.

All components was written from scratch and was builded by a heterogeneous team of designers, CSS,  PHP and JavaScript developers and copywriters. Everything was localized in 5 languages using a house-made system.

In 2015 the business control panel continues to be used and it is involved in a continuous refactoring and development.

projects.title: Provisioning services system
projects.description:
The provisioning system of products and services allows Dinahosting to manage demand and the products' life cycle. It integrates and manages several APIs, from internal ones, like Domain Name Services, hosting, VPS… to external services like goMobi.

The project is involved in a continuous refactoring and development in order to add new products and services.
